question: How may the width of the plank be divided and adjusted in this construction?
premises: The plank width is to be divided.
Division into nine parts is one option.
Adjustment by one part more or less is permitted.
inference: Having divided the plank width ninefold, one may adjust it by one part.
uncertainties: The exact sense of vārdhataḥ as increase or decrease is context-dependent.
plain_english: Having divided the width of the plank into nine parts, one may adjust it by one part.
